notes:
E-Sys MAX 4.8.0

Changes
- Safer coding: before Code NCD, E-Sys MAX now makes sure the SVT really was read from the car you are connected to.
- Dealer NCD packages with special letters in their file names now open.
- E-Sys no longer freezes for a few seconds when you open a tool right after an update.
- PSdZData unpacked straight onto a drive (like C:\) is now found and set up correctly.
- Check car connection no longer offers to close an E-Sys that is only showing a question.
- Only one E-Sys with E-Sys MAX opens at a time, so two versions never mix up your backups.
- Error messages can always be copied, also while an update is waiting.
- Stronger protection under the hood.

Your licence and settings stay the same after updating.

Thank you for using E-Sys MAX.
